metadata.description: Cowork OS marketplace — Claude Code plugins for Promega engineering teams. Ships two variants of the engineering plugin: a standard version that works for any engineer with the default Microsoft connector, and a Softserve variant that uses the Promega-internal Softserve MS365 MCP for richer meeting-sync data. Install only one.

plugins.name: promega-engineering-os
plugins.description: Standard version. Promega process and automation engineering workspace shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer. Scaffolds a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional add-ons (Change Controls, DS Revisions, Commissioning, Documentation), three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general), Outlook meeting sync with transcript summarization, team-sharing workflow, and an ISA-88 / FactoryTalk Batch reference tuned to FERMB. Built and tested at the Arnold Center (RDC) for fermentation production support; works for any Promega engineering team on the Logix 5000/500 + FactoryTalk Batch / PhaseManager stack. Use this variant if you don't have access to the Softserve MS365 connector — it works with the default Microsoft connector. **Install only one of the two variants.**

plugins.name: promega-engineering-os-softserve
plugins.description: Softserve variant. Same workspace and commands as the standard plugin, but meeting-sync is rewired onto the Promega-internal Softserve MS365 connector (Microsoft Graph). Unlocks: four-column Attendees table (Email, Response, Attended, Minutes), Recurrence row from series-master fetches, Recording row from list-meeting-recordings, and simpler transcript matching by createdDateTime (no base64 ID decoding). Also adds get-current-user as a name-resolution fallback in /join-team. **Requires the Softserve MS365 connector enabled in Claude Customize.** If you don't have Softserve access, install the standard promega-engineering-os instead — workspace files written by either variant are forward-compatible. **Install only one of the two variants.**
